description: Diagnostic families frozen before repeated timing; rotations are paired variants, not independent puzzles.

cases.purpose: Original small board; preserve a favorable DFS example.
Original split board; compare first-answer latency with answer quality.
Original chained teleports; inspect A* node reduction.
Control: a forced path leaves little useful search guidance; compare overhead.
A shallow goal beside a large open region; isolate DFS action-order sensitivity.
Many alternatives and a distant goal; compare guided search, breadth and long DFS answers.
A nearby goal behind a wall; quantify how weak geometric distance can be.
Short risky path versus longer safe path: BFS minimizes steps, UCS/A* minimize weighted cost.
A visible isolated goal forces exhaustive search; report no-solution separately from timeout.
